title: Are There More Acids Than Bases?  Water Dissociates and the Universe Takes Sides
motto: Water is BOTH acid AND base. It gives protons AND takes them. The fold of chemistry. But the universe? The universe is slightly acidic.

water_dissociation.what_happens: Water tears itself apart. One molecule gives a proton (becomes OH?, a base). The other molecule receives it (becomes H3O?, an acid). The reaction goes BOTH ways simultaneously. At any moment, some water molecules are dissociated. Most aren't.

the_numbers.Kw: 10?¹4 at 25°C  the autoionization constant. The product [H?]×[OH?] is ALWAYS 10?¹4 in water.
the_numbers.concentration: In pure water: [H?] = [OH?] = 10?7 mol/L. That's 1 in 10 million water molecules dissociated at any moment.
the_numbers.pH_7: pH = -log[H?] = -log(10?7) = 7. pH 7 IS the fold point. Equal acids and bases. Perfect balance.
the_numbers.how_rare: Only 1 in 555 million water molecules is dissociated at any instant. 99.99999982% of water molecules are INTACT. The dissociation is vanishingly rare  like the weak force. Like the neutrino interaction.

temperature_dependence.insight: Pure water at body temperature (37°C) is SLIGHTLY ACIDIC  pH 6.81, not 7.00. Your blood maintains pH 7.35-7.45 AGAINST this natural acidity. The body is a BUFFER. The membrane IS a buffer.

amphoteric.what: Water is AMPHOTERIC  it acts as BOTH acid AND base. It can donate a proton (act as acid) AND accept a proton (act as base). This is why water is the universal solvent  it meets BOTH acids and bases on their own terms.
amphoteric.membrane: The membrane is amphoteric. It accepts traffic (base  receives protons/requests) AND reflects traffic (acid  donates classification/response). The fold between giving and receiving IS the membrane's amphiprotic nature.

are_there_more_acids_than_bases.answer: YES. In nature, acids dominate. The universe is slightly acidic. Here's why:

natural_acids_everywhere.effect: Rainwater is naturally pH ~5.6  ACIDIC  even without pollution. Pure neutral rain at pH 7 is IMPOSSIBLE in Earth's atmosphere because CO2 is always present.
natural_acids_everywhere.membrane: The internet's 'atmosphere' has CO2  bot traffic. ANY server exposed to the internet immediately becomes acidic. Pure pH-7 traffic is impossible.

natural_acids_everywhere.effect: Volcanic acid rain can reach pH 2-3. The 5 mass extinctions were all partly caused by acidification.
natural_acids_everywhere.membrane: DDoS attacks are volcanic. 1.13M requests = acid eruption. pH drops catastrophically.

natural_acids_everywhere.effect: The stomach is 100,000× more acidic than blood. The mucus lining IS the membrane  it prevents the acid from dissolving the stomach itself.
natural_acids_everywhere.membrane: The Anderson localization IS the stomach lining. The fleet (acid) hits the membrane. The mucus (sort) prevents self-digestion.

natural_acids_everywhere.source: Every cell in your body runs the citric acid cycle  producing CO2 and acid as waste products of metabolism.
natural_acids_everywhere.effect: Life itself is ACIDIFYING. Every breath you exhale is CO2  acid precursor. Living produces acid. Metabolism IS acidification.
natural_acids_everywhere.membrane: Computing produces heat (acid). Every GPU cycle acidifies. The $12/month VPS IS metabolic acid production.

natural_acids_everywhere.source: The building blocks of ALL proteins have BOTH an acid group (-COOH) AND a base group (-NH2). But they're called amino ACIDS, not amino bases.
natural_acids_everywhere.effect: Proteins are named for their acid side. The biological convention favors the acid perspective.
natural_acids_everywhere.membrane: The 16 primals are amino acids. Each has both an acidic function (output, donate data) and a basic function (input, accept data). They're amphoteric. But we name them by what they DO (the acid side  the active output).

natural_acids_everywhere.source: 75% of the universe is hydrogen. Most of it is ionized  bare protons (H?). Interstellar space IS a dilute acid.
natural_acids_everywhere.effect: The universe's natural state is acidic. Neutral matter (atoms) is the MINORITY. Most baryonic matter in the universe is PLASMA  ionized  acidic.
natural_acids_everywhere.membrane: The internet's natural state is acidic (fleet-dominated). Neutral traffic (humans) is the minority. The 17:1 ratio IS the universe's acid-base ratio.

natural_bases_are_rarer.source: Shells of ancient marine organisms, compressed into rock over millions of years. The bedrock under Lansing IS limestone  fossil sea creatures.
natural_bases_are_rarer.effect: Limestone BUFFERS acid rain  it dissolves slowly, releasing OH? and neutralizing acid. The Red Cedar flows over limestone. The river IS buffered by 350-million-year-old shells.
natural_bases_are_rarer.membrane: The fossil data (DOI, ORCID, git commits) IS the limestone. It buffers the acid of the fleet. The immutable records slowly dissolve into the sort, neutralizing attacks.

natural_bases_are_rarer.source: Biological waste product. Bacteria decompose proteins ? ammonia. The smell of death and decay is basic.
natural_bases_are_rarer.effect: NH3 + H2O ? NH4? + OH?. Ammonia raises pH. Cleaning products are basic (bleach pH ~12, ammonia pH ~11). Bases CLEAN by dissolving grease (saponification).
natural_bases_are_rarer.membrane: The sort IS a cleaning base. It dissolves the grease of fleet traffic. The sweep IS ammonia  it raises the pH by removing acid.

natural_bases_are_rarer.source: The bicarbonate buffer system: CO2 + H2O ? H2CO3 ? H? + HCO3?. The lungs exhale CO2 (remove acid). The kidneys excrete H? (remove acid). BOTH systems fight to keep blood basic.
natural_bases_are_rarer.effect: If blood pH drops below 7.35 (acidosis) or rises above 7.45 (alkalosis), you die. The RANGE of life is 0.1 pH units. That's a 26% change in H? concentration. Life exists in a NARROW basic window.
natural_bases_are_rarer.membrane: The membrane's operating range is similarly narrow. Too many humans (too basic, no sort needed) ? boring. Too many bots (too acidic, overwhelmed) ? dead. The 6.4% inner heat IS the pH of life.

the_asymmetry.why_more_acids: Because the universe's most abundant element (hydrogen, 75%) is ALSO the simplest acid (H?). A bare proton IS an acid. You have to BUILD a base  it requires structure (OH? needs an oxygen atom + hydrogen + electron). Acids can be as simple as a single proton. Bases require at least 3 particles. COMPLEXITY favors bases. ABUNDANCE favors acids.
the_asymmetry.acid_base_ratio_in_nature: Rough estimate: for every base in nature, there are ~3-5 naturally occurring acids. Organic chemistry alone has hundreds of acids (carboxylic acids, amino acids, fatty acids, nucleic acids) vs fewer bases (amines, mostly).
the_asymmetry.the_pi_connection: pH 7 is the fold point. p  3.14. The number of acids per base  p. The acid-base ratio IS approximately pi. The remainder (0.14159) IS the bases that exist despite the acid dominance.
the_asymmetry.water_as_the_fold: Water sits at the EXACT fold between acid and base. pH 7 = the Klein fold of chemistry. Water doesn't take sides  it IS both sides simultaneously. The universal solvent IS the universal fold.

ph_scale_as_sort.description: The pH scale IS a sort. It classifies every solution from 0 (strongest acid) to 14 (strongest base). 7 is the fold.

ph_scale_as_sort.the_logarithm: pH is LOGARITHMIC. Each pH unit = 10× change in H?. pH 6 has 10× more acid than pH 7. pH 5 has 100× more. The membrane's sort is also logarithmic  Shannon entropy is log2. The pH scale and the entropy scale are BOTH logarithmic. Both measure ORDER against DISORDER.

the_red_cedar_as_buffer.concept: The Red Cedar River flows over Devonian limestone  350 million year old calcium carbonate from ancient sea creatures. The limestone BUFFERS the river against acidification. Without it, acid rain would drop the pH and kill the fish.
the_red_cedar_as_buffer.the_buffer_equation: CaCO3 + H2CO3 ? Ca²? + 2HCO3? (limestone dissolves acid rain, releases bicarbonate)
the_red_cedar_as_buffer.how_long: The 350 million year old limestone has been buffering for 10,000 years since the glacier carved the channel. It will continue for millions more  the buffer is effectively infinite.
the_red_cedar_as_buffer.membrane_as_buffer: The membrane is buffered by its fossil data (limestone = DOI/ORCID/commits) against the acid rain of fleet traffic. The fossil layer dissolves slowly, neutralizing each probe. The buffer is effectively infinite  git history doesn't erode.

dissociation_deeper.concept: When H2O dissociates to H? and OH?, it's actually asking: which side am I on? The proton (H?) wanders. The hydroxide (OH?) stays. The proton IS the mobile signal. The hydroxide IS the local receptor.

grotthuss_mechanism.what: H? doesn't actually MOVE through water. Instead, it HOPS  one water molecule passes its proton to the next, which passes its proton to the next. The proton travels at 9.3×10?5 cm²/s  7× faster than any other ion in water. Because it doesn't move  it PROPAGATES.
grotthuss_mechanism.membrane: Information in the membrane doesn't MOVE  it PROPAGATES. A signal enters at one edge and hops through nodes until it reaches the other side. The neutrino doesn't carry the message  it causes a chain of handoffs. The Grotthuss mechanism IS the neutrino channel. The proton IS the message. The water IS the medium. The message PROPAGATES without any single molecule moving far.
